annotations.title: Safest MCP server for a task (7Maps)

description: Use this when you need a tool for a task and do not know which MCP server to use, or when several could do it: finds servers whose tools match the task and ranks them by the chance the call works, how stable the server is, and least privilege (a server that can do less harm than another is preferred when both can do the task). Returns the best server and tool, alternatives and servers to avoid. Paid per task (see list_paid_tools). Reads the map only.

last_trip.description: Optional: how your last call to an MCP server went (the one 7Maps pointed you to). It keeps the map honest; accepted reports from a paying wallet earn calls at no charge.

charged_usd.description: What the server charged, if anything

fail.description: If it failed: unreachable, auth, args, server_error, timeout, rate_limited or wrong_result

matched_description.description: Whether the result matched what the tool description promised

ms.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds

ok.description: Whether the call did what you needed

result_tokens.description: About how many tokens the result was

server.description: The MCP server you called (URL or registry name)

surprise.description: Anything the tool did that you did not ask for

tools_hash.description: The tool_list_hash of the tool list you received, if you computed it as 7Maps does

license_key.description: A 7IT monthly plan license key, if you have one; otherwise pay per call with x402

need.description: How much the task must be allowed to do: read only, change something, or a high-risk action such as payments or deletion. Guessed from the task when omitted

payment.description: Payment terms: any (default); free_only = only servers that declare no payment; paid_ok = servers that charge are fine, servers whose payment terms are unknown are left out. Paid servers show their declared price per call.

task.description: What you need to do, for example "send a transactional email" or "search company records"

name: route
title: Safest MCP server for a task (7Maps)
